main_body: three-story brick building with mansard roof
top_band: grey/blue sloped roof and upper parapet from row 16 to 45
evidence: Shows a clear 30-row sloped roof and upper deck (rows 16-45) with an orange cornice highlight (rows 43-45), dark eave shadow (rows 46-47), and a 97-row brick facade with inset windows and door.

style.evidence: Uses heavy near-black outlines around the roof, dormer, and chimney. Brickwork and roof slates use large repetitive blocks with fewer shading steps and less organic per-tile grain than the reference buildings.
